package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"os"

	"github.com/prince776/go-dst-kit/realworld"
)

var __w = realworld.New(realworld.Options{})

// A dangling symbolic link: os.Lstat describes the link itself, where
// Stat follows it (and fails). Code that skips or detects symlinks
// relies on the difference.
func main() {
	os.Remove("link")
	if err := os.Symlink("missing-target", "link"); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("symlink:", err)
		return
	}
	defer os.Remove("link")
	fi, err := os.Lstat("link")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("lstat failed")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("lstat: symlink", fi.Mode()&fs.ModeSymlink != 0)
	if _, err := os.Stat("link"); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("stat: dangling")
	}
}
